title: Wiz findings handed from the agent to wiz-connector

error.description: Set ONLY when Wiz could not be queried or the repository is not known to Wiz. The run then fails instead of closing the issue.

wiz_scope.description: What was queried in Wiz, for traceability.

other_findings_count.description: Open Maven findings for packages NOT in the direct dependency list (counted, not listed).

package.description: Maven coordinates groupId:artifactId (artifactId alone if Wiz only gives that)

fixed_versions.description: All fixed versions Wiz lists (one per release line); empty if none

url.description: Wiz portal link to the finding, if available
